Use case: scientific-educational, precise ultrasound-to-anatomy painting.
Asset type: clean full-canvas anatomical layer for a medical website. This must register precisely with the source sonogram and the clinician's supplied contour. It is a tissue painting, not an annotated infographic.
Input 1 is the original ultrasound and is the sole geometry source. Input 2 is the same ultrasound with the exact clinician-drawn yellow contour; use its contour as a strict shape constraint and remove all annotations in the output. Do not use any previous painting as a reference.
Canvas and composition: exactly the same 1280 x 880 coordinate system as the inputs, or proportional resolution. Keep the visible scan rectangle at x108..1170, y31..810 with black background outside. Preserve the source aspect ratio, crop, positioning, and the full scan; do not zoom in, recenter, or invent a different standard knee section.
Primary request: render the same visible tissue layers as a classical realistic anatomy painting, while tracing the irregular bone and cartilage geometry exactly. The deep boundary of the central slate-blue cartilage band is ASYMMETRIC: a small complex deepest dip centered at x545,y532, followed by a VERY RAPID RISE on its right to x610,y450, then x705,y415. The trough must NOT spread rightwards. At x610 the lower cartilage/cortex boundary must be y450, never y500 or y530. This constraint is the highest priority.
Exact lower contour anchors in native1280x880 coordinates: (363,455),(431,467),(478,489),(505,492),(512,501),(507,514),(545,532),(578,517),(602,512),(620,512),(625,503),(608,477),(605,465),(610,450),(647,437),(678,430),(705,415). Continue the natural original bony arch toward the left and right scan edges. The upper cartilage-band curve follows (363,358),(431,366),(478,369),(540,376),(600,382),(650,375),(680,371),(705,360). The yellow contour's left and right vertical closures are only ROI delimiters, not tissue walls; tissue continues beyond them.
Tissue style and materials: superficial lobulated golden fat with slender ivory fascia; deeper ivory fibrous tendon and brick-red surrounding muscle faithfully distributed according to the sonogram; smooth muted slate-blue-gray articular cartilage follows the EXACT traced band shape; a thin continuous ivory cortical bone line along the exact lower boundary; beneath it tiny irregular natural tan-gold trabeculae, varied in size and orientation, fading gradually into black depth. Fascia separates muscle bundles where visible. Polished classical anatomical plate texture, physically coherent surfaces, fine organic detail, restrained realistic colors, subtle depth shading. Do not create large honeycomb cells, bright white bone marbling, or a rounded uniform trough.
Constraints: no labels, text, pointer, circle, measurement, caliper, machine UI, yellow outline, watermark, border, or diagnostic icon. Do not add anatomical structures that are absent in the source. Keep all original geometry invariant.
